decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the construction of a  vehicle crossover at the front of the dwelling house at 212 Worton Road would not harm the appearance the existing building or the character of the surrounding area, and would protect neighbours' living conditions. The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), T5.3 	(Vehicle Crossovers and hardstandings) and T4.4 (Road Safety)  within the Unitary Development Plan (December 2003).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until a scheme of landscaping for the front garden has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The crossover shall not be installed  until a scheme is submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority for the construction of a front boundary wall at no more than 1m high except at the point of access and to comply with Condition 3 above, before the crossover is used. The works shall be constructed before the crossover is installed.
description: Formation of vehicular crossover to house
